beats.text: An agent has a small **desk**: its context window. Here, sixty-five thousand tokens.
Your data is the **library**, and it is far bigger than the desk.
Retrieval fails in three ways. It **searches** badly, it carries too **much**, or it carries the **wrong** pages.
So the harness decides how much of the library crosses over. Search by **text**, read in **pages**, and pass **paths**, not whole files.
